function: Over-the-air FL aggregation of voting-based TopK-sparsified model updates, with energy and denoising-factor optimization, over single-antenna client-PS links without RIS. p. 5: "hi is the channel coefficient between client i and the PS".
notes: Exclusion reason system (Step 1, item 6): an area-7 work (over-the-air FL aggregation) whose links have a single antenna at the clients and at the PS, with no RIS. p. 5 (eq. for Ut and Table I): "hi is the channel coefficient between client i and the PS", a scalar; p. 10: "we model wireless channels between clients and the PS with IID Rayleigh fading. In our simulator, hi is generated from an Gaussian distribution N (0, 1) for different i". The paper never states antenna counts and has no beamformer, receive combiner, or RIS; the only antenna mention (p. 3) is about related work [26], "where the PS employs multiple antennas". Earlier codes do not apply: research article; FL over the air passes no_learning; Phase 2 aggregates by over-the-air computation (p. 5: "the transmitted waveform symbols are automatically superimposed to complete the aggregation operation"), with power (energy) and denoising-factor design, so it is area 7 rather than above_phy or function. Quantitative results exist (accuracy on MNIST and CIFAR-10, pp. 10-12). PDF first page holds the title and DOI 10.1109/JSAC.2024.3431568.
